lingchat_maid_bridge.configuration.title: LingChat Maid Bridge
lingchat_maid_bridge.configuration.bridg: When off, no port is opened. Useful for telling the mod apart from the plugin.
Listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Must match the address configured in the LingChat plugin.
Show the character's replies as a bubble above the maid.
Also print the replies to the chat box, visible to the maid's owner only.
